ocr.markdown:
Here's what's cookin': Springtime Spinach Dip
Recipe from the kitchen of: Mom        Serves:
2 c. mayonnaise
1 10oz frozen chopped spinach, cooked & drained
½ c. chopped green onion
½ c. chopped parsley
1 tsp salt
½ tsp pepper
Combine mix well. Chill
several hours or overnight.
